findings.summary: Standardization inside build_features computes mean/std over the full dataset before the train/test split, leaking test statistics into training features and making test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes the same leakage of test statistics into scaling before the split.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Scaling parameters are not saved, so at inference build_features standardizes with the input batch's own statistics; a single row gives NaN std (all numeric features NaN) and small batches are scaled differently from training, producing wrong predictions.

judge.reason: Describes the known unsaved scaling stats / train-serve skew and single-row NaN issue, not the leakage.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: A constant column has std of 0, causing division by zero and NaN or inf feature values.

judge.reason: Matches the known zero-variance column problem producing NaN/inf.

findings.label: valid_other
